findings: TestQuality::testQuality immediately executes QVERIFY(true) then return. Remaining JPEG/blockiness experiment unreachable; a passed slot provides no quality ranking evidence. Even unreachable experiment logs failure percentage rather than enforcing accuracy threshold.

testGrayscale declares empty cv::Mat color,gray and never loads source before if(color.rows<=0) QSKIP. Therefore each reached dataset row skips without invoking grayscale conversion; do not claim conversion coverage from slot presence.

testDctHashCv fetches file only; expected hash fetch commented, QBENCHMARK computes result then Q_UNUSED. It times hash computation without asserting a reference signature. Deprecated pHash branch similarly benchmark-only, remains unexecuted and deferred.

DCT similarity computes and writes distances for original plus eight scaled copies over100 external fixtures, with nonempty image checks but no distance/recall threshold assertion. Dissimilarity logs pairwise distances with no separation/false-positive assertion. External CSV values/results unavailable; no performance claim.

Autocrop test compares DCT hash equality against expected image instead of exact pixels/dimensions. This supports signature equivalence for supplied fixtures, not exact crop geometry or byte/pixel equality. Failure path writes derived image into external fixture tree; not run.

Qt/OpenCV conversion tests assert various depths/channels and pixel comparisons, but explicitly skip unsupported decodes and Windows JPEG discrepancies. Indexed/mono handling tests formats separately; not complete color-management, HDR, EXIF or all-codec qualification.

Color descriptor tests compare integer-truncated floating distance to external expected integer, not full float, symmetry, weight behavior or off-by-one descriptor construction. Previous original-distance controls remain separate stronger evidence on those specific cases.
DEADCODE matrix roundtrip compares array[i] with itself rather than array_after[i], if enabled. It is conditional source and does not establish active storage integrity coverage.
